name: OnaCla Maid Life ~Class no Gyaru Maid to Resort Gohoushi Seikatsu~
original_name: おなクラ メイドライフ～クラスのギャルメイドとリゾートご奉仕性活～
source:
Starting tomorrow, the long-awaited summer vacation finally begins. My parents are constantly traveling overseas for work, and on top of that, I have zero friends.
So my summer has always been the same: retreating to an enviable tropical resort, accompanied only by the hired household staff.
But this year, my parents are busier than ever, and even the servants have no time to spare.

“Hey, I heard you were looking for someone for a part-time job. Mind telling me what kind?”
“Wait, a job as a servant!? At a tropical resort!? And I even get to wear a maid outfit!?”
“I’ll do it! I’m absolutely doing it!”
“Um, hey… could it be… that it’s just the two of us?”

A resort where the summer sun is strong enough to tan you in minutes. And beside me is a gyaru classmate—high in the school caste—now serving as my maid.
translation:
从明天开始，期待已久的暑假终于开始了。我的父母经常出国工作，最重要的是，我的朋友为零。
所以我的夏天一直都是一样的：隐退到令人羡慕的热带度假胜地，只有雇佣的家庭工作人员陪伴。
但今年，父母比以往更加忙碌，连佣人都没有闲暇。

“嘿，我听说你正在找人做兼职。介意告诉我什么样的吗？”
“等等，仆人的工作！？在热带度假胜地！？而且我还可以穿女仆装！？”
“我会做的！我绝对会做的！”
“呃，嘿……难道……只有我们两个人吗？”

夏季阳光充足的度假胜地，几分钟之内就能把你晒黑。在我旁边的是一位辣妹同学——在学校中地位很高——现在担任我的女仆。
